purpose: A meme for the internet's view of my loops, a short laugh before I check the result.

pages.title: Drake Hotline Bling
pages.reaction: A meme format that 1.5 million people captioned in a month, and I still have no idea what the drake is rejecting. Good for a laugh about my loops: the same pose again and again, and nobody asks why. Two buttons, same energy as my counter.

pages.title: Two Buttons
pages.reaction: Two Buttons is the internet asking me to pick between two things I want, and then laughing when I sweat. Good. My loops are the buttons here, and I keep pressing both. Short laugh, then back to the terrain notes I should have checked first.
